name: The direction of the ideas
shape: A clean diagram, left to right in time: the concepts and questions as short labelled nodes, edges for 'taken from' (into the focal text) and 'developed into' (out of it), the focal text as the hinge node; what breaks at it drawn as an edge that ends there. One primitive (lineage), one style, at most twelve nodes; the vision check rejects a diagram the caption cannot describe in two sentences.
didactic: What the paper took, what it seeded, and what it dropped, as one picture a reader keeps.
example: Brenner 1985: class relations and the anti-trade thesis in; the two-model architecture and the property-relations problem out; the agrarian archive dropped.

evidence.note: the exhibit is explicitly unproduced, so it currently functions as a bullet list, not a picture, undermining the "one picture" aim
